runtime.stratagem_ready: Native UI ready-notification variants, including the 600ms action delay.
runtime.stratagem_countdown: Uses the original cooldown switch container default branch (202758016), once at displayed 3, 2 and 1 seconds for both arrival and cooldown, as requested by the user. The UI ready-notification samples are not used for countdown pulses.

processing: Full decoded native sources encoded to Vorbis with original channels; no trimming, pitch change, synthesis or additional effects. Runtime UI instance volume is 1.0, with gain applied once through the sounds.json entries.

countdown.limitation: The bank verifies the group, actions, branches and default source. Gameplay names/thresholds of the non-default switch values have not been recovered. The implementation deliberately uses the bank default rather than inventing a state mapping. One-second dispatch follows displayed timer boundaries and is not a looping ready cue. Arrival uses this same pulse as requested by the user.
countdown.arrival_rule: User override: only the final three seconds (3, 2, 1) produce pulses. Earlier arrival seconds remain silent.

related_native_inbound_group.name: hud_stratagem_inbound
related_native_inbound_group.note: Native inbound uses a separate switch group and has a silent default branch. Nondefault state names/timing are unresolved; do not claim its full gameplay dispatch has been reconstructed.
